prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a parking lot collision. The patient had 10 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1100; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text:
Treatment Summary

The patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot and reported neck pain and stiffness consistent with a cervical strain. Over the course of ten visits, care consisted of conservative management including gentle range-of-motion exercises, soft tissue therapy, and instruction in a home stretching program. The injury mechanism described is a plausible explanation for the symptoms reported. Examination revealed reduced cervical range of motion and paraspinal muscle tenderness that support the diagnosis, while neurological screening and reflex testing were within normal limits. No prior injury to the cervical region is known from the patient's history. The course of treatment followed a typical progression, with visit frequency tapering as pain and mobility improved. Billing records reflect one charge per scheduled service with no duplicate or repeated entries.
